findings.title: Service targets a port the pods do not declare
findings.cause: Service web sends port 80 to port 80 on its pods, but they declare only port 8080; if nothing listens on 80, every connection fails

evidence.command: kubectl get service web -n kd-service-wrong-target-port -o jsonpath='{.spec.ports}'
kubectl get pod web-59c4f75cc7-rpxwp -n kd-service-wrong-target-port -o jsonpath='{.spec.containers[*].ports}'

findings.fix: Set targetPort to the port the app listens on (the pods declare 8080), or declare the port in the pod spec if 80 is right.
